description: This file contains tests for CLI container target parsing, resolution, and execution within a project called openclaw. It primarily tests functions that parse CLI arguments related to container targeting, resolve container names from environment variables or args, and conditionally execute commands inside containers via podman or docker, handling environment setup, container state checks, and special command cases.

methods.name: parseCliContainerArgs
methods.description: Parses CLI arguments to extract the '--container' flag and its value, handling different argument formats and placement within the command line.

methods.name: resolveCliContainerTarget
methods.description: Determines the container target name based on CLI args or environment variables, with args taking precedence.

methods.name: maybeRunCliInContainer
methods.description: Handles executing the CLI command inside a specified container, checking container state, choosing between podman or docker, handling environment variable setup, and avoiding recursive calls or unsupported commands.
